g.text: Discrete ordinal Exactly one edit · six-text comparison
Within-line × exact-character-length shuffles · Ordinary Levenshtein distance = 1 (%) · identities excluded · differences in percentage points
Row-specific scales; fixed across layout variants. The same spelling rule is used for all texts; Voynich characters are EVA transcription.
Poetry: independent pages, every source line intact · ordinal offsets; identical across all three spacing settings
★ target excluded; hatching excludes later words on the current line. Gray = unavailable or insufficient support. Red = excess; blue = deficit.
Each row keeps a common observed/null scale and a symmetric difference scale; ranges differ by row, with no color clipping.
Voynich retains its earlier JS-run eligibility: compacted 2+ character positions, geometry/feature-safe pairs, within-page windows.
Controls retain original word slots. Poetry preserves each source line on independent pages: 48 lines/page, new pages at books; no wrapping.
Both poetry coordinate systems stop at these synthetic page boundaries. Exact historical pagination is not reconstructed.
Different features, eligibility, source windows and sample sizes make these a descriptive comparison, not a calibrated test of uniqueness.
